sourceSupplements.pointerScope: Trusted browser touch events on supplied controller assets; controlled local WebSocket transport. Actual TV response is a separately labelled host fixture.
sourceSupplements.protocolScope: Controlled public native-host input snapshots with the real shared runtime and production game. Separate from trusted controller touch transport; no physical Android/LAN/phone claim.
sourceSupplements.visualGapScope: Actual ordinary browser sessions for missing original-image coverage; declared partial stops are not terminal wins. All reads are sparse.

syntheticBlurScope.attempted: Second actual page brought to front
syntheticBlurScope.scope: Browser focus behavior only; not a physical phone or operating-system lifecycle test
syntheticBlurScope.fallback: Explicit synthetic window blur event; isTrusted false, no real-device claim

firstFailure.scope: Initial helper expected different Chinese action wording. Production labels already matched game.json; no pointer edge or host gameplay run had begun.

sparseCandidateAudit.scope: Lossless selection and segmentation only. Projection time is not game time; no execution, geometry, lifecycle or independent-audit pass is asserted.
limitations: Checks public projections; declared source hashes and capture provenance require independent source review.
JSON cannot prove identity, detached arrays, deep freezing, getter/proxy behavior, or absence of hidden code; non-JSON raw values need separate accurately typed evidence.
Display message content is not a decision field; only type/length is checked except exact creation and exact no-op snapshots.
Does not establish renderer visibility, actual phone contact/release, browser lifecycle, recording readability, or hardware performance.
Ordinary endpoint mode requires legal canonical rail positions and authentic receipt origins; injected mathematical or invalid-state fixtures are not ordinary runs.
All sparse interval continuity, unseen movement, input edges, dt and gate changes remain not-observed or review-required.
Embedded receipts are checked for arithmetic consistency only; no embedded history becomes an observed adjacent transition.
Equal endpoint placements do not exclude intervening forward/back movement; endpoint counts do not reveal individual calls.
Source indices, segment boundaries, parent clocks and retained host wrappers are preserved claims requiring source review.
Menu/null-model observations are retained but have no model endpoint to check.

acceptedVisualLimitation.reason: Crossing at actual geometric point lies close to the port. Its badge is partly covered in four images, while separate conflict counts, exact highlighted cable spans, terminal selection and current guide direction remain legible. Does not prevent identifying remaining invalid geometry or playing. No claim every point badge is fully unobstructed.

candidatePeerScopeLimits: All 14 files in candidate-first were individually inspected. Three files are byte-identical and count as one distinct visible state.
This set contains staggered-clamp live views and 960px outcome overlays; it does not supply live initial screenshots of all three tasks at both resolutions.
Still images do not establish complete action history, held-input release, uniform rigid translation timing, pause freezing, retry behavior, browser frame rate or texture/draw-call metrics.
No phone-controller original appears in this directory. These desktop browser captures do not claim physical-phone or physical-TV validation.
This candidate review does not pre-approve later final captures, video, package or publication.
dualOriginalReviews.controllerPeerScope: Actual browser controller screenshots; no physical phone, Android WebView or network-device claim. The visible layout supports full-right-third upper/lower actions, while hit testing and input behavior require the separate execution evidence.
dualOriginalReviews.gapsScope: All 42 original files individually viewed by QA. Four actual point markers are partly occluded near selected a; root accepted the documented limit. Task2 contact repairs on the winning move, with no separate unobscured repaired active image.

acceptedLimitations: Actual point-conflict badge partially covered near a in task2 initial/firstmove; separate counts/highlighted cables/guides clear, accepted in root supplementary visual review.
Browser headless focus did not produce trustedblur; explicitly syntheticblur fallback only.
No physicalTV/phone test; observed APIcall counts notdeviceFPS.

rootAcceptedLimitations: Near-a point badge partly occluded by original port hardware; counts and overlap guides remain explicit.
Automatic initial-workbench shows menu and remaining-conflict shows won. Separate retained supplements provide initial active overlap and active contact.
Sparse observations are not exact state-frame evidence; export30fps is not deviceFPS; no physical TV/phone validation.
encodedOriginals.peerAcceptedMinorLimitation: The exact point-conflict badge near terminal a in clamp-first-move and the supplemental initial-active frame is partially occluded by port hardware/focus styling; numerical pair counts remain explicit and clear. Later reviewed placements show the point badge unobscured. This limitation existed in the source JPEGs.
encodedOriginals.scope: Readability and actual visible correspondence accepted; source and encoded originals agree with no material new compression-related legibility issue. No replay or re-encode.
limitations: Visual comparison is of these selected originals only, not every video frame or the complete recording timeline.
Visible encoded/source correspondence does not establish exact correspondence to a separately sampled model observation. Two automatic candidate state labels demonstrably differ from the images.
No source frame was modified or replaced and no misleading candidate filename was relabeled by this reviewer; the mismatch is retained in this report.

The original eleven-pair set does not visibly demonstrate the initial active overlap or the temporary coincident-node state. The two separately inspected supplemental pairs now provide those visible states without replacing the two automatic misattributions.
No full-video decode, replay, re-encode, physical-device validation, render timing or control-history certification was performed. Encoded frame rate is not claimed as device performance.

cover.scope: Dual-reviewed active Chinese UI; exact retained decoded frame from the software browser recording.
